definitions.gloss: selfish; self-centered; thinking only of oneself
definitions.explanation: Acting solely in one's own interest without regard for the feelings or needs of others.

examples.japanese: {身勝手|みがって}なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{身勝手|みがって}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone is troubled by his selfish behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{身勝手|みがって}すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}わない→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Don't you think it's too selfish to change the schedule just to suit yourself?

notes:
Compound of ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (self, body) + ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ (one's own convenience). Stronger in tone than ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身勝手|みがって}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (selfish behavior)
- {身勝手|みがって}な⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧ (a selfish reason)
- {身勝手|みがって}な⟦{言|い}い{分|ぶん}→言い分：06874_iibun⟧ (a self-serving argument)

USAGE:
Always negative in connotation. Implies the person is disregarding others while pursuing their own wishes. Similar to {自分勝手|じぶんがって} and ⟦{我|わ}が→我が〜：03971_waga⟧まま, but {身勝手|みがって} tends to sound slightly more serious or accusatory.
